root_cause.note: kueueviz backend imports net/http/pprof and defaults KUEUEVIZ_AUTH_MODE to Disabled.

evidence.analysis: Kueue kueueviz backend: KUEUEVIZ_AUTH_MODE defaults to 'Disabled' (server.go:49) and main.go:112 only mounts the TokenReview authenticator middleware when the mode equals TokenReview, so a default deployment serves cluster queue/workload routes (and websocket data) without authentication; config/server.go also imports net/http/pprof with a localhost:6060 listener in dev mode. Not run end-to-end: the backend requires a live kubeconfig/apiserver; recorded as a verified-by-source default-auth posture.
